Calculate the interpolated scalar value $S_P$ using the linear combination of vertex scalars weighted by their respective barycentric coordinates [S1, unofficial].

The claim states that the interpolated scalar value $S_P$ is calculated using a linear combination of vertex scalars weighted by their respective barycentric coordinates. The evidence in Source [S1], specifically section 3.4.1, explicitly states: 'We sample vertex-centered data by interpolating the scalar data at the vertices associated with the current element, using the barycentric coordinates of the sample point inside the sampled element.' In the context of finite element methods and barycentric interpolation, this process is mathematically defined as a linear combination of the vertex values weighted by the barycentric coordinates. Therefore, the evidence supports the claim.
